verses.translation: By the dawn
and the ten nights
and the even and the odd
and the night when it passes

verses.arabicText: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
verses.translation: Is all this ˹not˺ a sufficient oath for those who have sense

verses.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
verses.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka biʿādin
verses.translation: Did you not see how your Lord dealt with ’Ȃd—
˹the people˺ of Iram—with ˹their˺ great stature

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
verses.transliteration: Allatī lam yukh'laq mith'luhā fī l-bilād
verses.translation: unmatched in any other land
and Thamûd who carved ˹their homes into˺ the rocks in the ˹Stone˺ Valley
and the Pharaoh of mighty structures
They all transgressed throughout the land
spreading much corruption there
So your Lord unleashed on them a scourge of punishment
˹For˺ your Lord is truly vigilant

verses.arabicText: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
verses.transliteration: Fa-ammā l-insānu idhā mā ib'talāhu rabbuhu fa-akramahu wanaʿʿamahu fayaqūlu rabbī akraman
verses.translation: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”

verses.arabicText: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-ammā idhā mā ib'talāhu faqadara ʿalayhi riz'qahu fayaqūlu rabbī ahānan
verses.translation: But when He tests them by limiting their provision, they protest, “My Lord has ˹undeservedly˺ humiliated me!”
Absolutely not! In fact, you are not ˹even˺ gracious to the orphan
nor do you urge one another to feed the poor
And you devour ˹others’˺ inheritance greedily
and love wealth fervently

verses.arabicText: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Kallā idhā dukkati l-arḍu dakkan dakkan
verses.translation: Enough! When the earth is entirely crushed over and over
and your Lord comes ˹to judge˺ with angels, rank upon rank

verses.arabicText: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wajīa yawma-idhin bijahannama yawma-idhiy-yatadhakkaru l-insānu wa-annā lahu dh-dhik'rā
verses.translation: and Hell is brought forth on that Day—this is when every ˹disbelieving˺ person will remember ˹their own sins˺. But what is the use of remembering then
They will cry, “I wish I had sent forth ˹something good˺ for my ˹true˺ life.”
On that Day He will punish ˹them˺ severely, like no other
and bind ˹them˺ tightly, like no other
˹Allah will say to the righteous,˺ “O tranquil soul
Return to your Lord, well pleased ˹with Him˺ and well pleasing ˹to Him˺
So join My servants
and enter My Paradise.”
